body: AZ 175th Street LLC, owner of a mixed-use building in Jamaica, Queens, filed a voluntary Chapter 11 petition on October 10, 2026 in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Eastern District of New York, Case No. 1-26-44763. According to a filing alert from the bankruptcy tracker Bondoro, the company reports $14 million in assets and $12.6 million in liabilities and indicates funds will be available for unsecured creditors. By October 20, the docket showed the petition, a notice of prior filings, a deficient-filing notice, a meeting-of-creditors notice and one notice of appearance.

This is the company's second Chapter 11 case. The first, No. 1-25-42550, was filed May 23, 2025, and a week later the debtor refiled the petition's first pages to designate itself a single-asset real estate business. Creditor UC 175th Street Apartments Holder, LLC appeared in early June and moved to dismiss the case on June 18, 2025, supported by declarations and an affirmation from the property's receiver. After adjournments and a September 12, 2025 hearing, the court entered an order on October 9, 2025 dismissing the case and barring the debtor from refiling. The case was closed April 16, 2026.

The public docket descriptions available without charge do not state the length of the refiling bar or whether the dismissal was by consent, and the new case does not yet show a motion by a secured creditor.
